verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a catalog of auditor-vetted native integrations and an MCP server for AI assistants. Through the MCP server, an assistant can add attachments and status updates to evidence requests. That is an AI-assistant interface, a related but different feature. Nothing in the pack documents a public API that developers can use to build private or custom integrations that push evidence or test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover
